description: Points de vente SNCF is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Liste des points de vente physiques implantés dans les gares SNCF, hors équipements Transilien. Les points de vente regroupent les guichets physiques ainsi que les automates. Les adresses des points de vente sont indiquées dans le jeu de données. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Services voyageurs. Its keywords are Points de vente. The portal shows 2026-01-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
